G001.target_statement: Enhance the podcast experience for end users and creators by strategizing and implementing features
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 受访者直接描述其角色即为策划并落地提升终端用户与创作者播客体验的功能，主体、对象与动作与原文一致。

G002.target_statement: Bring new creators onto the platform, offering them deals other platforms would not offer
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: T039 明确陈述上月引入 2,000 余名新创作者并提供其他平台给不了的待遇；T009 的 get them on board 作为同源上下文，其指代不明已在问题中记录，未据此扩大目标范围。

G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: 原文直接说明其工作包含与跨职能团队协作，作为独立协作动作与引入创作者拆开保留。

G004.target_statement: Ensure defined system requirements by outlining the features and functionalities the platform should have at the bare minimum to meet user needs
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 受访者把定义系统需求、列出满足用户需求的最低功能集称为首要职责；未编造具体阈值或功能清单。

G005.target_statement: Collaborate on shared requirements with stakeholders and creators and get their input
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 原文直接陈述就共享需求与涉众、创作者协作并征求其意见，主体与范围一致。

G006.target_statement: Be the best platform in the market for both users and creators
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: 原文明确表述想成为市场上对用户与创作者都最好的平台；未添加衡量标准或排名依据。

G007.target_statement: Ensure back end systems are effective and efficient
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: 原文直接说明要确保后端系统有效且高效，状态型要求按原文保留，未转成具体性能指标。

G008.target_statement: Give users the right experience as soon as they log on to Spotify
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: 原文明确称这是 main goal，主体为用户、时机为登录后即刻；'right experience' 无判定标准，已在问题中记录，未编造验收口径。

G009.target_statement: Focus on and prioritize the user recommendation system above other improvements
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: T017 与 T053 两处均明确把推荐系统列为首要目标与当前主焦点，优先级信息写入 context，未升级为强制验收项。

G010.target_statement: Improve accessibility features in the platform
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: 原文两处直接说明改进无障碍功能及其具体项，强度 utmost importance 保留在 context。

G011.target_statement: Strengthen community engagement among listeners and bring communities of users together
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: T017 与 T037 表达同一社区凝聚意图，属同义合并，未新增原文没有的社区形态。

G012.target_statement: Offer creators tools so that they stay on the platform
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: 原文明确表述要为创作者提供使其留在平台的工具；具体工具类型未说明，缺口写入 context 与问题，未具体化。

G013.label: inferred
G013.rationale: 原文只说关注用户参与度这一指标，未直接说要提升它；按关注即追求改善的推断成立，但缺少目标值与明确提升表述，故判 inferred，并在问题中提请确认。

G014.target_statement: Grow the number of active users
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: 原文直接把 growth in active users 列为关注指标，增长方向与主体明确，未加入具体增幅或时限。

G015.label: inferred
G015.rationale: 原文仅说明关注留存指标，未陈述提升留存的动作或目标值；按指标关注推断改善意图，同 G013 一并保留问题。

G016.target_statement: Broaden the reach of the platform, especially to non-English speakers
G016.label: direct
G016.rationale: 原文直接说 want to broaden our reach 并说明动因，未把非英语人群写成唯一范围。

G017.label: direct
G017.rationale: T019 与 T043 均直接说明支持多语言与方言，属同一能力要求的跨窗确认，未增加具体语种数量。

G018.target_statement: Develop and use AI driven recommendation engines that use user themes, semantic memory and listening history to match users with similar preferences
G018.label: direct
G018.rationale: T019 与 T031 描述同一推荐引擎建设动作（语义记忆、主题与历史用于相似偏好匹配），跨窗合并，未加入原文没有的算法指标。

G019.target_statement: Deliver personalized content and recommendations to users
G019.label: direct
G019.rationale: 原文明确说交付个性化内容是推荐引擎带来的结果，并与后端个性化推荐相呼应；作为结果与引擎建设分列，未等同。

G020.target_statement: Let users input their interests openly through frequently given feedback forms in order to tailor their experience
G020.label: direct
G020.rationale: 原文直接说明通过频繁反馈表单让用户公开输入兴趣以定制体验，方式与目的均来自原句。

G021.target_statement: Ask users open-ended questions every now and then about whether they enjoyed a podcast and what else they want to listen to
G021.label: direct
G021.rationale: T033 的定期提问与 T039 的开放式提问指向同一做法，合并保留；与反馈表单（G020）区分在于目的为多样化与避免饱和。

G022.target_statement: Ensure high quality standards for podcast content
G022.label: direct
G022.rationale: 原文直接陈述确保高质量标准，并以字幕等做法支撑；未把'high'改写成具体评分线。

G023.target_statement: Provide transcriptions and closed captions for each and every podcast
G023.label: direct
G023.rationale: 原文明确为每一期播客提供转写与字幕，范围 each and every 保留，未弱化为部分内容。

G024.target_statement: Give users multiple ways to watch or get the experience of a podcast
G024.label: direct
G024.rationale: 原文直接说明提供多种消费方式；未列举原文未提的具体方式。

G025.target_statement: Help people with special needs get hold of the content and enjoy it to the utmost point
G025.label: direct
G025.rationale: 原文直接说明多种消费方式帮助有特殊需求的人获取并充分享受内容，主体与结果一致。

G026.target_statement: Detect and flag inappropriate or prohibited content with moderation tools and automated screening, so that the platform does not become an anarchy where anyone just uploads anything
G026.label: direct
G026.rationale: T023 的审核工具与 T025 的自动筛查指向同一检测与标记动作，合并保留；不愿平台成为无秩序上传场所的否定表述作为目的保留在 statement 中。

G027.target_statement: Offer creators content optimization suggestions and insights so that they can improve their podcasts
G027.label: direct
G027.rationale: 原文直接说明向创作者提供优化建议与洞察以改进其播客，主体为平台、对象为创作者。

G028.target_statement: Evaluate every podcast through a strict process pipeline
G028.label: direct
G028.rationale: 原文直接说明遵循严格的流程管线来评估播客是否达标；与质量结果（G022）区分，未把具体步骤全部并入。

G029.target_statement: Assess podcast quality so that audio quality and production standards are up to mark
G029.label: direct
G029.rationale: 原文直接说明评估音频质量与制作水准达标，未加入具体技术阈值。

G030.target_statement: Segregate podcasts by content category so that suggestions give users what they actually need
G030.label: direct
G030.rationale: 原文直接说明按内容分类并据此给用户所需建议，动作与目的均出自原句。

G031.target_statement: Take user feedback reviews and the ratings listeners give into account
G031.label: direct
G031.rationale: 原文直接说明采纳用户反馈与评分，作为评估流程中的独立结果保留。

G032.target_statement: Monetize the platform while maintaining a positive user experience, keeping a balance between the two sides
G032.label: inferred
G032.rationale: 原文没有一句话直接声明该平衡目标，它由问答语境与三类做法归纳而来，故判 inferred 并写明依据与假设；未编造取舍规则或收入目标。

G033.target_statement: Offer a premium subscription that gives users an ad free experience for a monthly or yearly payment
G033.label: direct
G033.rationale: 原文直接说明付费（月付或年付）换取无广告体验，金额未具体化，未添加价格。

G034.target_statement: Implement targeted advertising that shows users relevant ads and minimizes disruption
G034.label: direct
G034.rationale: 原文直接说明投放相关定向广告并尽量降低打扰，方式与限制同句保留。

G035.target_statement: Balance ad load so that the frequency and placement of ads does not distract or detract the user from the experience
G035.label: direct
G035.rationale: 原文直接说明控制广告频率与位置以避免打扰，两个并列维度（频率、位置）均保留。

G036.target_statement: Minimize ads for new users in order to encourage exploration and obtain preference data
G036.label: direct
G036.rationale: 原文直接说明对新用户尽量减少广告以鼓励探索并获取数据，适用人群限定保留。

G037.target_statement: Give new users introductory offers such as a free trial of 2 to 3 months
G037.label: direct
G037.rationale: 原文直接说明给新用户 2 到 3 个月免费试用等入门优惠，时长期间按原文保留。

G038.target_statement: Offer long-time listeners customized recommendations based on their listening history
G038.label: direct
G038.rationale: 原文直接说明对长期听众按收听历史提供定制推荐，人群限定与依据均保留。

G039.target_statement: Offer premium users exclusive content such as behind the scenes material and early access to episodes
G039.label: direct
G039.rationale: 原文直接说明为付费用户提供独家内容（幕后、提前收听），频次 sometimes 与对象 premium 保留。

G040.target_statement: Avoid disrupting the listening experience by placing ads only at the start or the end of podcasts and not in between
G040.label: direct
G040.rationale: 原文直接说明广告通常只放片头片尾且目的为避免打扰收听；明确选定的放置方式与其目的同目标保留，未改为禁止插播广告的强制约束。

G041.target_statement: Be transparent and clearly label sponsored content and advertisements in order to maintain trust between users and the platform
G041.label: direct
G041.rationale: 原文直接说明对赞助内容与广告保持透明、清晰标注以维持信任，方式（标注）与目的同句保留。

G042.target_statement: Let users set their interests through user preference settings throughout their journey
G042.label: direct
G042.rationale: 原文直接说明采用偏好设置让用户全程设置兴趣，与反馈表单（G020）为不同入口，故分别保留。

G043.target_statement: Leverage social sharing and integrate social media to enhance recommendations from what people share with friends or family
G043.label: direct
G043.rationale: 原文直接说明借助社交分享与社交媒体增强推荐，目的与来源均明确。

G044.target_statement: Diversify what users get: do not restrict them to only what the algorithm feeds them, and offer fresh, new and more unique content rather than only what they ask for
G044.label: direct
G044.rationale: T033 的不受限与新鲜内容、T039 的更独特内容指向同一多样化意图，跨窗合并；未把'独特'改写成具体多样度指标。

G045.target_statement: Keep users on the platform instead of losing them to competitors such as Youtube music because they disliked the content offered
G045.label: direct
G045.rationale: 原文直接说明希望用户留在平台而不因内容不合意转向竞品；T047 的小体验让用户开心并留在平台为同义上下文。

G046.target_statement: Do not compromise on UI/UX, the navigation experience and the small details while improving the platform
G046.label: direct
G046.rationale: 原文直接说明不在 UI/UX、导航体验和细节上妥协，否定与对象保留，未转成验收标准。

G047.target_statement: Encourage new users to engage more with podcasts
G047.label: inferred
G047.rationale: 该目标本身由问答语境与所列举功能归纳，原文无一句话直接声明，故判 inferred 并写明依据；未声称这些功能已穷尽。

G048.target_statement: Provide a share button or a rate button within the podcast so users see how others feel about it
G048.label: direct
G048.rationale: 原文直接说明在播客内提供分享或评分按钮及其作用，位置限定（播客内）保留。

G049.target_statement: Let anyone and everyone create their own playlists, and let people like and save those playlists
G049.label: direct
G049.rationale: 原文直接说明任何人都可创建播放列表并点赞、收藏，创建者与操作者范围按原文保留。

G050.target_statement: Create theme based groups and forums
G050.label: direct
G050.rationale: 原文直接说明创建主题小组与论坛，'try and' 的尝试强度保留。

G051.target_statement: Host live events such as live podcast sessions and QA with creators
G051.label: direct
G051.rationale: 原文直接说明近期开始举办直播播客与创作者问答，形式与对象保留。

G052.target_statement: Avoid content saturation so that users can easily discover new podcasts
G052.label: direct
G052.rationale: 原文直接说明这就是他们避免饱和的做法；易于发现新播客是该问答所指向的结果，未加入发现率等指标。

G053.target_statement: Do not constrict the platform to a limited number of creators who would then have a monopoly over it
G053.label: direct
G053.rationale: 原文直接以否定形式表达不愿平台被少数创作者垄断，避免型意图按原文保留。

G054.target_statement: Bring people from multiple ethnic backgrounds and varying languages onto the podcast platform
G054.label: direct
G054.rationale: 原文明确表述引入多民族背景与多语言人群（并后悔做得太晚），遗憾指向时机而非方向；未把'people'限定为创作者或听众，该歧义写入问题。

G055.target_statement: Scale AI driven recommendation systems without processing so much data that high latency and low loading times ruin the user experience
G055.label: direct
G055.rationale: 原文直接说明不愿因处理海量数据导致高延迟、慢加载而破坏体验，避免型意图与条件保留，未加入具体延迟阈值。

G056.target_statement: Enable users to navigate Spotify via voice and via their keyboards
G056.label: direct
G056.rationale: T043 与 T047 均直接说明语音与键盘导航，属同一无障碍能力，跨窗合并；未扩展到其他无障碍形式。

G057.target_statement: Maintain consistent app behavior and performance across all devices
G057.label: direct
G057.rationale: 原文直接说明要在所有设备上保持一致行为与性能，'try and ensure' 强度与设备举例保留。

G058.target_statement: Keep the mobile code base and the web UI code base separate instead of a common back end infrastructure
G058.label: direct
G058.rationale: 原文直接说明因设备内存差异而拆分移动端与 Web 代码库，所选方式与动因保留，未改写为通用架构原则。

G059.target_statement: Optimize algorithms so that functionality is not sacrificed and the platform gets more efficient day by day
G059.label: direct
G059.rationale: 原文明确称之为 objective：不牺牲功能并逐日提升效率，双条件保留。

G060.target_statement: Roll out regular updates that implement a new feature about every two months
G060.label: direct
G060.rationale: 原文直接说明约两个月一次的常规更新与新功能发布；睡眠定时作为已发布示例列入 context，未单列为维持型目标。

G061.target_statement: Invest in infrastructure, software and data science teams and hire them from top colleges
G061.label: direct
G061.rationale: 原文直接说明在基础设施与软件、数据科学团队上投入并从名校招聘，投入对象保留。

G062.target_statement: Ensure developers are happy and content
G062.label: direct
G062.rationale: 原文直接说明要确保开发者满意，状态型目标按原文保留，未转成留任率等指标。

G063.target_statement: Minimize clicks and make the UI smoother with fewer clicks
G063.label: direct
G063.rationale: 原文直接说明减少点击、让 UI 更顺滑，方式与进行中状态保留，未设定点击数上限。

G064.target_statement: Integrate the search bar directly in the UX instead of a search button that opens the search bar
G064.label: direct
G064.rationale: 原文直接说明已把搜索栏直接集成进 UX，明确选定的方式保留；已实现不自动加为强制要求，仅按原文记录。

G065.target_statement: Let users send Instagram or Whatsapp messages to their groups about podcasts with the pictorial representation captured
G065.label: direct
G065.rationale: 原文直接说明用户可直接向各自群组发送 Instagram/Whatsapp 消息并带图示，渠道与图示要求保留。

G066.target_statement: Give users daily mixes of podcasts that are new to them and that the platform thinks they would like listening to
G066.label: direct
G066.rationale: 原文直接说明提供每日混合新播客，频率与'我们认为用户会喜欢'的限定保留。

G067.target_statement: Be much subtler with podcast recommendations than with music, giving listeners more avenues to explore that do not deviate too much
G067.label: direct
G067.rationale: 原文直接说明播客推荐必须比音乐更含蓄，并限定探索方向不能偏离太多；'do not deviate too much' 的程度限制保留。

G068.target_statement: Act like an end user when listening to podcasts in order to give users the right and best experience
G068.label: direct
G068.rationale: 原文直接说明要以终端用户视角收听以便给出最好体验，主体为其本人，未扩大为团队流程要求。
